basic_details.job_title: BBAU Young Professional II Recruitment 2026 – Walkin

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 30 years. Upper age limit is relaxable for 5 years for SC/ST/Physically Handicapped/Female candidate. All things being equal SC/ST candidates will be preferred as per GOI rules.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | young professional ii: PhD Horticulture in Fruit Science. Desirable: Experience of work in Aquatic Crops.

how_to_apply: Prepare an application on plain paper providing your Name, Permanent and Correspondence address, name of Father and Mother, telephone number, and e-mail address.
Include details of your educational career starting from High School or equivalent.
Gather self-attested copies of all mark-sheets, certificates, domicile certificate, and details of any research or other experience.
Send the complete application via email to [email protected] or [email protected] within minimum 2 weeks from the date of advertisement.
Attend the walk-in interview directly on the scheduled date along with your documents.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for the post of Young Professional II under a PPV & FRA, GOI, New Delhi sponsored project at Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University (BBAU), Lucknow.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: The exact number of vacancies is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 22/10/2026 at 11:00 am.

faq.question: Q4. What is the venue for the interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at Room No. 011, Department of Horticulture, SBBT Phase-I, BBAU, Lucknow.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a PhD Horticulture in Fruit Science, with desirable experience in aquatic crops work.
